part.text: All tests pass. The fix is a one-line change in `internal/communicator/communicator.go:234`: `RunScripts` now calls `r.Comm.Disconnect()` via `defer` immediately after the connection is established, so the SSH connection closes as soon as all scripts finish executing. Previously it only disconnected via a goroutine waiting on `ctx.Done()`, which left connections ESTABLISHED after provisioning completed (and also leaked a goroutine per run).
